## Summary of Changes

Describe what this PR accomplishes, and link any related issues.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / performance improvement

## Testing Performed

- [ ] Automated tests added/updated and passing (`pytest`)
- [ ] Linter passing (`ruff check .`)
- [ ] Manual verification with Vivado TCL or Web UI

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary
- [ ] I have updated documentation in both English and Thai if applicable
